reason: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness web UI panel for managing local plugin development. Its core purpose is developer workflow support: discover local file/link-installed plugin candidates, register/unregister projects, open sources, and launch guided development/upload sessions. No direct git/gh execution is claimed by the plugin; upload/update actions are intended to stay inside user-confirmed host sessions, so the risk is medium (R1) due to local project metadata handling plus possible external publish workflows.

capabilities: Scans local profile package.json entries to discover file:/link: plugin candidates
Allows users to explicitly register/unregister local development projects
Validates project paths with realpath before inclusion
Opens plugin source directories through host workspace/file-manager integration
Creates workspace-session workflows for continue-development prompts
Surfaces guided upload/update GitHub publish flows with risk constraints
Stores managed project registry in local DSH config
Depends on host services and user-authorized external Git/GitHub flow
